dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature on the trailing edge; spline shows a continuous inward arc from the dorsal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; classified as rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 55-degree posterior inclination relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 0.85:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curve with a large radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak structure with a low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle at the pixel junction where the melon convexity meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast luminescent cyan and white pigmentation pattern across the dorsal and mid-flank regions.
